Done — wrote `research.md` in the workspace.

**Summary**
- Current LTS (as of 2026-08-11): Node.js 24.x "Krypton" (latest v24.19.0). Node 22 is maintenance LTS; Node 26 is still Current.
- Requirements per official `BUILDING.md` (v24.x): Windows 10/Server 2016+ (x64, arm64; no 32-bit), macOS 13.5+, Linux with glibc ≥ 2.28 / kernel ≥ 4.18 (x64, arm64, ppc64le, s390x), AIX 7.2 TL04+, SmartOS 18+, plus build toolchain minimums (GCC 12.2, Xcode 16.1, VS 2022/2026).

**Sources** — all primary, all retrieved 2026-08-11 02:22 UTC, free path only (no paid SERP):
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/v24.x/BUILDING.md
- https://nodejs.org/en/blog/migrations/v22-to-v24
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/Release/main/README.md
- https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json

**Gaps hit**
- No official RAM/CPU/disk specs exist — Node.js only documents OS/arch/libc minimums.
- Alpine/musl and FreeBSD are experimental only (no official binaries).
- The learn/install docs page 404'd; BUILDING.md + migration guide used instead.
